description: A cruise shore day in Florida that ends at the pier with time to spare: pick the port (PortMiami, Port Everglades, Port Canaveral, Port Tampa Bay, JAXPORT, Key West), when the ship docks and the all-aboard time, and get up to 3 of our own picks near the port in order with drive times, the time to leave the last stop, and the pier-by time (45 minutes before all aboard). Drive times are estimates, the ship does not wait, the person decides. Also use it when someone asks what to do near a Florida cruise port for a few hours.

all_aboard.description: The ship's all-aboard time, e.g. 4:30 PM or 16:30

docks.description: When the ship docks, e.g. 8 AM (default 8:00 AM)

lang.description: Language for the descriptions and category names: en (default), es (Spanish), pt (Portuguese). Use the language the person is writing in. Place names stay as on the sign.

mood.description: beach (default), old (Old Florida), rain, wild, weird, road

name: shore_day
title: Cruise shore day
